probabilityMethod: Mutually exclusive base, upside and downside cases; probabilities must total 100% per decision
ebitdaFormula: Sum of scenario EBITDA impact multiplied by scenario probability
npvProxyFormula: Probability-weighted midpoint-discounted EBITDA multiplied by cash conversion, less upfront investment
discountTiming: Operating cash is approximated at the midpoint of the benefit horizon
overlapTreatment: Decision-level planning reserve applied after probability weighting; not a consolidated forecast elimination
roundingPolicy: Calculations use unrounded USD; presentation rounds to one decimal million
